source_title: Kevin Gehrmann Joins PKF O'Connor Davies as Partner in Commercial Tax Practice - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
WOODCLIFF LAKE, N.J. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PKF O'Connor Davies, one of the nation's largest accounting, tax and advisory practices, today announced that Kevin Gehrmann, CPA , has joined the organization as a Partner within its Commercial Tax practice. He is based in the organization's Woodcliff Lake office .
Gehrmann brings nearly 20 years of public accounting and corporate tax experience, with deep expertise in federal, state and international tax planning and compliance, as well as tax provision preparation. Throughout his career, he has advised Fortune 500 multinational corporations and privately held businesses on complex tax matters, including tax consulting, transfer pricing and research and development tax.
"Kevin combines large-scale multinational tax experience with hands-on tax practice leadership, making him a valuable addition to our clients and our team," said Benjamin Beskovic , Tax Service Line Leader at PKF O'Connor Davies. "His background in public accounting, corporate tax and tax department operations makes him exceptionally well-suited to serve our clients' most complex tax needs."
Gehrmann's appointment reflects PKF O'Connor Davies' ongoing commitment to expanding its Commercial Tax capabilities and delivering sophisticated, integrated tax services to clients across a broad range of industries.
Before joining PKF O'Connor Davies, Gehrmann served as Tax Partner at a regional accounting firm, where he led tax department operations and technology initiatives, including tax automation and artificial intelligence. He previously worked at two "Big Four" accounting firms, advising corporations and pass-through entities on federal, state and international tax matters and leading global tax engagements for Fortune 500 companies. His experience also includes an in-house role as Tax Manager at a multinational corporation.
Gehrmann earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Business Administration with a concentration in Accounting from Montclair State University . He is a Certified Public Accountant licensed in the State of New Jersey.
PKF O'Connor Davies is a top-tier accounting, tax and advisory practice and member of PKF Global, a global network of accountancy firms. We have a long history of serving domestic and international clients. "Know Greater Value" speaks to the confidence and guidance that our clients realize when they work with us. It reinforces our commitment to delivering the highest levels of value, expertise and service in everything we do. Our clients Know Greater Connections, Know Greater Insights and Know Greater Value. "PKF O'Connor Davies" is the brand name under which PKF O'Connor Davies LLP and PKF O'Connor Davies Advisory LLC, independently owned entities, provide professional services in an alternative practice structure in accordance with applicable professional standards. PKF O'Connor Davies LLP is a licensed CPA firm that provides attest services and PKF O'Connor Davies Advisory LLC and its subsidiary entities provide tax and advisory services.
